title: Beyond Open Offices: The New Fog Creek Headquarters
summary: Fog Creek's office tour: private offices for developers kept as a productivity booster, plus mixed spaces for a company that is half remote and half non-coders.

assertions.quote: the research is pretty clear that it is a massive booster of productivity for people in those kinds of technical roles
Some of these tasks require intense concentration, while others are more conversational and collaborative

verdicts.note: Workplace design advice rather than a testable prediction.

Removing all spatial boundaries cut face-to-face collaboration about 70%, and the authors tie this to Kao and Couzin's finding that intermediate rather than maximal openness maximises collective intelligence; supports that fully open space hurts both kinds of work but does not test separate spaces.

assertions.quote: work space really matters. It’s a fundamental part of how you take care of your people
